attributes.body: Q&A forum, knowledge base, user training, newsletter, event management...all in one place. Commune works as a customer communication hub and strengthens community engagement by displaying optimized experiences for each customer, all with no code. Hey Product Hunt! I’m super excited to launch Commune, a customer community platform for customer success teams🌟 —How Superblocks got the idea— I and my co-founder used to run another startup and wanted to scale customer success by leveraging the power of community. However, all community solutions Superblocks could find were for creators, for a hobby, or for brand promotion and Superblocks couldn’t find any community software built for customer success teams to improve customer retention... So Superblocks decided to build it :) Being the industry leader with multi-million $ revenue in Japan, Superblocks is super excited to launch Commune in English! You can start for free, and Superblocks is thrilled to offer the professional plan($299/mo) free for 3 months to the PH community✨ Also, I'm happy to give you a quick intro session to walk through the features.
